entities.summary: Ahmad Reza Mamduhi is an Iranian translator, author and an iconic figure in the Iranian Esperanto movement. He is best known for his prolific contributions to the Iranian Esperanto Association, as well as publishing two salient books, Aasaan-tarin zabaane donyaa (2005) — a comprehensive step by step Persian textbook concerning with learning/teaching Esperanto — and Padide-ye Esperanto (2007) — originally written in Esperanto by Nobel Prize-nominated William Auld, entitled La fenomeno Esperanto. He has also written numerous articles in cultural magazines chiefly in the field of Esperantic Studies.
